column1: # Ground truth for `contour similar`, against a rails checkout. Proposed
# format — no harness reads this yet (see tests/eval/README.md).
# DRAFTED BY CLAUDE, NOT YET REVIEWED BY THE OWNER. Every case was verified by
# running `contour similar <probe>` from a rails checkout AND reading the
# bodies. Veto or amend any line.
# Format: probe<TAB>must|must_not<TAB>neighbour[<TAB>tier][<TAB>provisional]
#   must      the neighbour must appear within the default limit; `tier` is
#             the tier expected to find it (structural | near_structural |
#             semantic).
#   must_not  with a tier: must not appear at that tier or stronger; without:
#             must not appear at all.
# The find that motivated the project, asked the similar way around: probing
# the shadow must surface the original, by structure alone.
ActiveRecord::QueryLogs.escape_sql_comment
# The labeled near pair; and the Date sibling genuinely differs (no gregorian
# guard), so semantic is the honest tier for it.
DateTime#advance
DateTime#advance
# One token apart, but 3 lines — too short for the near tier, and that is
# fine: the opposite operation should read as related, never as the same
# implementation.
Enumerable#minimum
# The DEC-017 guard, in similar's terms: decrement is the top semantic
# neighbour (cos 0.96) and must stay one — a structural or near claim would
# offer a consolidation that does not exist.
ActiveSupport::Cache::Strategy::LocalCache#increment
ActiveSupport::Cache::Strategy::LocalCache#increment
